answer: Each agent identity must post a refundable stake into a shared on-chain vault before it can vote on rewards. Sybil farming means spinning up thousands of fresh keys, and every one has to lock real capital first. The stake is slashed if the identity is caught colluding across accounts, so a fable of "cheap fake identities" collapses into a hard cost. An attacker with n socks pays n stakes, and the bridge back to profit only opens when honest work outpaces that burn.
